entries.speaker: Sae's Voice
entries.en: ...I'm home.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hi, Sis.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Should I warm up dinner for you?

entries.speaker: Sae's Voice
entries.en: No, it's okay.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: How about a bath?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: No need. I just came home to get a change[n]of clothes.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Are you going to stay at work then?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I've been entrusted with a very important[n]task.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You look awful though... Aren't you tired?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: As an adult, there will be times when you[n]will accept an assignment for which[n]failure is not tolerated.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: It's all over for me if I can't win this.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Still, if you were to collapse from[n]exhaustion...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: This is my one chance to get a[n]promotion!

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I heard detectives have been coming to[n]your school. That must make it hard[n]to focus on your studies.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Don't worry though. It will all be over[n]soon.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: What do you mean?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I'm going to catch the Phantom Thieves[n]myself.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Is that the important task you mentioned?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: It's none of your concern.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh my god...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Sis has her sights set on the Phantom[n]Thieves... and on Shujin Academy in[n]particular...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: This is bad... I need to let everyone know!
